استثنين (form X)
# اِسْتَثْنَيْنَ (istaṯnayna) /is.taθ.naj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اُسْتُثْنِينَ (ustuṯnīna) /us.tuθ.niː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اِسْتَثْنِينَ (istaṯnīna) /is.taθ.niː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
